name: Pipewright
summary: Build and watch automatic tasks between business tools on a blueprint-style flow canvas
about: An app for an operations team that builds automatic tasks between its tools and watches them run. Flows are drawn top to bottom on a blueprint canvas with branching if-else steps, a JSON sample payload and an execution trace. A live mission-control view sends a packet down each pipeline lane for every run, and executions open into a waterfall of step timings. Connections, incidents, alert rules and secret variables round it off.
how: Open the builder, find a step in the palette and click it to add it under the selected step, or drag it onto the canvas.
Drag from a blue square to another step to wire it, or click the square and then the step; click a wire to cut it.
Select a step to edit it in the inspector, edit the sample JSON payload, then press Test run to watch pulses travel the wires.
Publish a new version once the problem list is empty; the version number and status update.
Watch mission control: every live run sends a packet along its pipeline lane and adds a line to the live stream.
Open any execution for a waterfall of step timings and the input JSON, retry failed runs or pause the live table.
Triage incidents, switch alert rules on or off, and reveal, copy or edit variables per environment.
